name: J-Pharma Co.,Ltd.
summary: J-Pharma Co., Ltd. discovers and develops drugs that target amino acid transporters, especially LAT1 among the solute carrier transporters. Its compounds include JPH034, aimed at multiple sclerosis and other demyelinating diseases of the central nervous system. It performs functional and structural analysis of selected transporters and is preparing for clinical trials. Dating from 2005, it has its base in Yokohama, Japan.
